snippet.title: Entropy | Announcement Trailer
snippet.description:
Introducing a new RPG from the creator of Dread Delusion…

Entropy is a turn-based tactical game inspired by classic JRPGs. Assemble your party of mercenaries and forge your own path towards an expedition into hell to stop the demonic incursion. But take heed, Player. The choices you make along the way will determine the fate of your world.

Store page: https://dreadxp.games/EntropyYT
Follow the dev: https://x.com/LovelyHellplace // https://bsky.app/profile/lovelyhellplace.bsky.social
Join the official DreadXP Discord: https://discord.gg/PX25QrbGrw
